hardware.variant: CIX P1 CD8180; 32 GB; stock BiosV1.5-W20260706-e321056a; NVMe NE-256

inputs.name: Static envstat from the reduced CIX userland
Static wdogctl from the reduced CIX userland

scenario: Boot the kernel from the reduced SD root after removal of input power. Read dmesg, envstat and wdogctl at idle.
expected: The ACPI thermal zones, the NVMe temperature and the SBSA watchdog are visible to the standard tools.
observed: envstat listed acpitz0 to acpitz12 at 40-43 degC. acpitz0 to acpitz11 have a 98 degC critical limit; acpitz12 has none. envstat also listed the nvme0 composite temperature, 47.85 degC with 82.85 degC warning and 84.85 degC critical limits. sbsawdt0 attached at acpi0 with a 5 s default period. wdogctl listed swwdog0 and sbsawdt0. nvme0 attached as NE-256 with ld4.
limits: Idle readings only; no reference thermometer.
No watchdog was armed; expiry and reset are not tested.
The NVMe device was only enumerated and read; NVMe installation remains unaccepted.
